dialogDescription: Anyone who scans this opens "{{campaignName}}" straight away — no app, no login.
scanPrompt: Scan with any phone camera to open the form

shortLink.label: Short link
shortLink.unavailable: A short link isn't available right now. The form link above works exactly the same.
shortLink.useInQr: Encode the short link in the QR code
shortLink.useInQrHint: Fewer characters means a coarser pattern that scans from further away — but the code then goes through a redirect that can be switched off later.

missingLink: This audience list has no shareable link yet. Save the campaign and try again.

noExpiry.title: This QR code never expires
noExpiry.body: It encodes the form's own address rather than a short link, so there is no redirect in between that anyone can switch off. Print it once and it keeps working.

shortLinkInQr.title: This QR code depends on the short link
shortLinkInQr.body: It points at the short link rather than the form itself, so switching that link off later stops every printed copy. For posters and standees, leave this off.

print.cta: Point your phone camera at the code

toasts.downloadFailed: Could not generate the QR image
toasts.printFailed: Could not open the print view
toasts.popupBlocked: Allow pop-ups for this site to print the QR code
